note: Game balance values for soldiers (not real-world data). Damage per hit = caliber base x zone multiplier; 100 HP per life. Loadout pools include sandbox / later-war weapons (StG 44, M3, FG 42): they are not a claim about 6 June 1944 issue.

kits.note: SW1: AI types Blaster troopers (trooper) and Robot commandos (robot): the soldier brain in the kit's body (content/characters/<model>.glb, local-only bakes; missing: the soldier body), carrying only the kit's weighted blasters (no sidearm, no grenades), on either side. robot: hp share, pace and aim-turn factors, hits spark instead of bleeding.
kits.allied_note: NA1: AI type Allied soldiers: the user's allied_animations clips (FigRig, retargeted by tools/bake_gunbody.py --retarget) on the ranger bodies, a body per gun (bodies: [model, weapon] in turn: its clips hold that gun), the game's guns drawn in the clips' hands (gunbody.cpp deltaBodyPose clipHold), the M1911 carried (its pistol clips are in every body); local-only bakes
kits.delta_note: DF1: AI type Delta Force: the user's Mixamo rifle / pistol / grenade packs in one body (content/characters/delta_force.glb, local-only: missing, the soldier body), the game's guns in procedural hands (gunbody.cpp deltaBodyPose); the primary weighted per slot + life, the sidearm in turn per slot, frags per life

loadouts_operator.note: AI5: Operator bots (AiType::Operators) draw from these modern weapons instead of the faction pool and the class weapons: weighted primary, every lmgEvery-th operator on a side carries the LMG, all carry the sidearm; TK1: one in launcherEvery also carries the launcher, used on armour and heavy enemy types. Grenades stay the side's (no modern grenade is modelled). Battle Royale keeps its bare-hands start (royale loot rules).

operator_models_note: AI type Operators: soldiers (the same brain, weapons and procedural pose) wearing these bodies, one per AI in turn; a missing file leaves the faction's soldier body (tools/bake_ai_characters.py operators, docs/credits.md)
gunbody_models_note: NA1: gasmask2 (AI type Gas-mask soldiers 2: the user's gasmask_animations clips with the GM1 gas-mask body, 16 guns; Vector fires as the UMP-45, M249 CS2 as the LMG), ss (SS soldiers: ss_animations on its own body, weighted Kar98k 2, MP40 2; local-only bakes). GM1 / GM2: bodies with the gun built in (tools/bake_gunbody.py; gunbody.cpp drives their clips), [model, weapon] taken in turn: gasmask (AI type Gas-mask soldiers), desert (AI type Desert soldiers), german (the Axis side's plain soldier bots, not in Battle royale; the weighted order stands in for the class mix). The weapon gives the ballistics and sound; desert_vector fires as the UMP-45 (no Vector), desert_scar as the SCAR-H. A missing file or weapon: the soldier body as before
